history: At the Comune or the Questura someone will hand you un modulo, a form to fill in. The word is the Latin modulus, a ‘small measure’, from modus, ‘measure, manner’. A modulus was a standard size, and in architecture it was the unit from which all other measures of a building were taken. The idea of a fixed pattern spread. A modulo is a printed pattern with empty spaces in which you write your details, so that every applicant follows the same model. The same Latin root gave modo (way), modello (model) and moda, which came through French. In school or computing, modulo also means ‘a module’, a part of a course or a program, and in mathematics it means ‘remainder’.
